name: B10-0260/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Tanzania to release opposition leader Tundu Lissu, who was arrested in April 2025 and charged with treason over social media posts. It urges Tanzania to stop arresting government critics before the October 2025 elections, investigate police violence and disappearances, and halt executions. It also asks the European Union and its member states to press Tanzania on these human rights concerns. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Tanzania is asked to free Tundu Lissu and stop arresting critics before October 2025 elections.
- The European Union and member states are urged to raise these cases with Tanzania.
- No law changes; the Parliament is stating its position and pressure only.
